notes:
Context:
- Mid-market SaaS (product analytics) focused on in-app conversational assistant + search re-ranking for product docs and release notes.
- Started on Redwood hosted API for fast iteration. Now evaluating Dedicated for predictable latency and data isolation.

POC goals (Dedicated):
- 2-week canary: route 5% traffic initially, ramp to 25% then 100% if no regressions.
- Canary routing policies: canary by route + user cohort, health checks on p95 and token-error rates.
- Fallback plan: automatic route to hosted_api variant in other region on capacity/SLO breach; model-variant fallback to smaller quantized model for degraded mode.
- Rollback: automatic rollback if p95 increases >20% over baseline or error-rate >1% sustained 3m. Manual rollback option for business-hours as well.

Technical requirements / acceptance criteria:
- Latency: p95 < 120ms for short chat (<=512 tokens) at 50 qps sustained during POC.
- Throughput: handle 200 concurrent chat sessions; embedding batch throughput target 150/sec.
- Cost sensitivity: aim to keep per-token unit economics within 20% of hosted proofs; interested in Optimize recommendations (batching + quant profiles).
- Security: SSO/SAML + SOC2 + KMS integration + audit logging; data residency for EU users (route to eu-1).
- Model preferences: fine with open Llama variants and vetted open models; also wants a smaller fallback (4-bit quant) to reduce cost during high load.

Notes from calls:
- VP Eng (quote): "Need predictable p95 and clear rollback — we can't surprise customers during a launch."
- Product lead: wants canary by feature flag/cohort and a fallback that is transparent to end-users (degraded quality acceptable short-term).

Operational asks for Redwood:
- Provide an ops playbook for canary ramp and rollback triggers.
- Pricing scenario: reserved capacity monthly + burst billing; want 12-month and 3-month term comparisons.
- Run a short benchmark on their typical prompt set (attached) with 1) full model, 2) quantized variant, 3) region failover latency numbers.

Open action items:
- Redwood SE to deliver Dedicated POC SOW and playbook (Diego) — due 2026-03-12.
- Pricing from Sales for 3/12/12 month reserved tiers (Maya).
- Legal to review SOW and data residency addendum (PrismForge legal).

Stubs/links: pricing deck on Drive, security FAQ, call transcripts in Fireflies.
